tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Fetch any public URL and return a clean, readable markdown or JSON extract for AI agents. Pass the target as url (http/https). Costs 0.01 USDC on Base.

tools.name: token_price
tools.description: Real-time USDC-denominated spot price for an EVM token by contract address or common symbol. Provide address (0x...) or symbol (ETH, USDC, USDT, WETH) and optional chain (base, ethereum, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, avalanche, default base). Costs 0.01 USDC on Base.

tools.name: wallet_balance
tools.description: Query the native and USDC balance for any EVM wallet address. Provide address (0x...) and optional chain (base, ethereum, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, default base). Costs 0.02 USDC on Base.

tools.name: youtube_video
tools.description: Resolve any YouTube video URL (watch?v=, youtu.be, shorts, embed) to a direct MP4 download URL with title, uploader, and format metadata. Provide url (http/https). Costs 1.00 USDC on Base.

tools.name: youtube_audio
tools.description: Resolve any YouTube video URL to its audio-only stream download URL (m4a/webm when available) with title, uploader, and format metadata. Provide url (http/https). Costs 0.50 USDC on Base.
